description: Gemini Flash cross-module hard benchmark tasks. Fixtures require reading one support module and editing the target module.

tasks.task_desc: Fix cross-module retry backoff. runtime/retry_policy.py must read RETRY_LIMITS from runtime/settings.py and return exponential delays: attempt 1 = 1, attempt 2 = 2, attempt 3 = 4, attempt 4 = 8.
Repair the retry policy integration so compute_backoff uses settings.RETRY_LIMITS and doubles the delay until the configured maximum.
Fix the cross-module timeout retry bug: retry_policy.compute_backoff should preserve the existing settings import and compute capped exponential backoff.
